```{r clear_add_wingspan, include=FALSE}
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), setup_objects))
invisible(gc())
```

# Comparison with the 2024 compilation

Each species of the 2024 manual compilation is mapped to its current representative key and its interaction type and partner breadth are compared with the rebuilt values; the supplement reports the agreement.

*Inputs:* species_traits.csv, synonym_database.csv, working tables names_2024_to_gbif.csv and species_clusters.csv; legacy_2024/Aug24_final_dataset.csv.  
*Output:* legacy_comparison.csv (one row per 2024 species).

```{r compare_legacy}
# --- Inputs ---
# Rebuilt species table, 2024 compilation and the 2024 names matched to the snapshot
N <- read_chr(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "species_traits.csv"), na = c("", "NA"))
leg <- read_chr(file.path(dir_data_raw, "legacy_2024", "Aug24_final_dataset.csv"),
                na = c("", "NA"))
drift <- read_chr(file.path(dir_working, "names_2024_to_gbif.csv"),
                  na = c("", "NA"))
leg$accepted_key <- drift$accepted_key[match(leg$species, drift$legacy_name)]
leg$legacy_match <- drift$match_type[match(leg$species, drift$legacy_name)]

# --- Current key of each 2024 species ---
# 2024 names without an accepted GBIF key map to the pseudo key of 'extra' taxa. The names
# are looked up in the synonym database as written and with underscores as spaces.
dm <- read_chr(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "synonym_database.csv"))
nn <- dm$normalised_name[match(gsub("_", " ", leg$species), dm$name_as_published)]
nn[is.na(nn)] <- dm$normalised_name[match(leg$species[is.na(nn)], dm$name_as_published)]
legkey_dm <- dm$gbif_accepted_key[match(leg$species, dm$name_as_published)]
legkey_dm[is.na(legkey_dm)] <-
  dm$gbif_accepted_key[match(gsub("_", " ", leg$species)[is.na(legkey_dm)],
                             dm$name_as_published)]

# Synonym-database key, else the snapshot match, else the pseudo key of an extra taxon
leg$accepted_key <- ifelse(!is.na(legkey_dm), legkey_dm,
                           ifelse(!is.na(leg$accepted_key), leg$accepted_key,
                                  ifelse(!is.na(nn), paste0("X:", gsub(" ", "_", nn)), NA)))

# The 2024 values, kept under legacy_ names
for (m in c("interaction_type", "host_breadth")) leg[[paste0("legacy_", m)]] <- leg[[m]]

# Representative key of the duplicate cluster of each key
CL <- read_chr(file.path(dir_working, "species_clusters.csv"))
rk <- setNames(CL$representative_key, CL$key)
leg$accepted_key <- ifelse(leg$accepted_key %in% names(rk), rk[leg$accepted_key],
                           leg$accepted_key)

# --- Comparison table ---
# 2024 species joined to the rebuilt values of their representative key
cmp <- merge(leg[, c("species", "accepted_key", "legacy_match", "legacy_interaction_type",
                     "legacy_host_breadth", "associated_ants", "citation")],
             N[, c("gbif_key", "interaction_type", "interaction_type_basis",
                   "interaction_type_status", "host_breadth", "host_breadth_basis",
                   "associated_ants", "all_class_claims", "cite_interaction_type",
                   "conflict_flag")],
             by.x = "accepted_key", by.y = "gbif_key", all.x = TRUE,
             suffixes = c("_legacy", "_new"))
cmp$legacy_host_breadth <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(cmp$legacy_host_breadth))
cmp$host_breadth <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(cmp$host_breadth))

# Agreement of the two values: neither, new_only, legacy_only, agree or disagree
cmp$type_status <- ifelse(
  is.na(cmp$legacy_interaction_type) & is.na(cmp$interaction_type), "neither",
  ifelse(is.na(cmp$legacy_interaction_type), "new_only",
         ifelse(is.na(cmp$interaction_type), "legacy_only",
                ifelse(cmp$legacy_interaction_type == cmp$interaction_type, "agree",
                       "disagree"))))
cmp$breadth_status <- ifelse(
  is.na(cmp$legacy_host_breadth) & is.na(cmp$host_breadth), "neither",
  ifelse(is.na(cmp$legacy_host_breadth), "new_only",
         ifelse(is.na(cmp$host_breadth), "legacy_only",
                ifelse(cmp$legacy_host_breadth == cmp$host_breadth, "agree",
                       "disagree"))))
write_table(cmp, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "legacy_comparison.csv"))

# --- Summary ---
cat("Interaction type, 2024 vs rebuilt (2024 species only):\n")
print(table(legacy = cmp$legacy_interaction_type, new = cmp$interaction_type,
            useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\nStatus of type comparison:\n")
print(table(cmp$type_status))
cat("\nHost breadth comparison:\n")
print(table(cmp$breadth_status))
both <- cmp[cmp$breadth_status %in% c("agree", "disagree"), ]
cat("breadth equal:", sum(both$breadth_status == "agree"), "of", nrow(both),
    " | new greater:", sum(both$host_breadth > both$legacy_host_breadth),
    " | new smaller:", sum(both$host_breadth < both$legacy_host_breadth), "\n")
```

# Consistency checks and release table

The ledger and species table are checked for registered sources, locators, unique keys, partner breadth recounted independently from the ledger, ledger support of every class, and biological consistency of classes in parasitic and obligate genera. The public dataset keeps one row per representative species with an evidence-strength tier (strong: an observation of the species or agreement of at least two independent source groups), and the column dictionary documents the full species table.

*Inputs:* evidence_ledger.csv, species_traits.csv; trait_evidence/sources.csv; trait_evidence/decisions/ parasitic_genera.csv, genus_presumptions.csv.  
*Outputs:* release/species_interaction_dataset.csv, release/column_dictionary.csv.

## Consistency checks

The notebook stops if any check fails.

```{r check_consistency}
# --- Inputs ---
L <- read_chr(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "evidence_ledger.csv"))
tr <- read_chr(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "species_traits.csv"))
S <- read_chr(file.path(dir_data_raw, "trait_evidence", "sources.csv"))

# --- Partner breadth ---
# host breadth recounted independently from the ledger
Q <- L[L$ant_qualifies == "TRUE" & !is.na(L$accepted_key), ]
rc <- tapply(Q$ant_count_group, Q$accepted_key, function(z) length(unique(z)))
tt <- tr[!is.na(tr$host_breadth), ]
same_breadth <- as.integer(tt$host_breadth) == as.integer(rc[tt$gbif_key])

# --- Ledger support of every class ---
# every class is supported by ledger rows, except genus-level presumptions and decisions
has_val <- !is.na(tr$interaction_type) &
  !(tr$interaction_type_status %in% c("presumed_genus_level", "presumed_genus_consensus",
                                      "presumed_phylogeny", "decision_override"))

# --- Classes in parasitic and obligate genera ---
# An 'f' or 'n' may never rest only on a bare attendance record (R6) or on relative-based
# presumed scores in a parasitic genus or in a genus presumed obligate mutualist.
PGg <- read_chr(decision_file("parasitic_genera.csv"))$genus
GPg <- read_chr(decision_file("genus_presumptions.csv"))
GPm <- GPg$genus[GPg$class == "m"]
Tg <- tr[tr$is_representative == "TRUE", ]
Tg$g <- sub(" .*$", "", Tg$canonical)
orach <- grepl("Orachrysops", Tg$cluster_members) & !is.na(Tg$cluster_members)
weak <- Tg$interaction_type %in% c("f", "n") &
  (grepl("R6", Tg$interaction_type_note) |
     Tg$interaction_type_basis %in% "presumed_relatives")

# --- Checks ---
# The notebook stops if any of them fails
stopifnot(
  "every ledger source_id is registered in sources.csv" = all(L$source_id %in% S$source_id),
  "every ledger row has a locator" = !anyNA(L$locator) && all(nzchar(L$locator)),
  "every ledger row has a species name" = !anyNA(L$species_as_published),
  "evidence_id unique" = !anyDuplicated(L$evidence_id),
  "gbif_key unique in species table" = !anyDuplicated(tr$gbif_key),
  "host_breadth equals independently recounted distinct ant groups" =
    all(same_breadth, na.rm = TRUE),
  "host_breadth only for species with qualifying ant records" =
    all(!is.na(rc[tt$gbif_key])),
  "interaction_type values have ledger support" =
    all(as.integer(tr$n_ledger_rows[has_val]) > 0),
  "no species typed n with qualifying ant records" =
    sum(tr$interaction_type %in% "n" & !is.na(tr$host_breadth)) == 0,
  "duplicate GBIF species rows carry no trait values" =
    all(is.na(tr$interaction_type[!is.na(tr$gbif_duplicate_of)])),
  "extra (non-GBIF) taxa have a stated reason" =
    all(!is.na(tr$extra_reason[tr$universe_status != "gbif_accepted"])),
  "no species of a parasitic genus typed f/n on bare attendance or presumed scores" =
    !any(weak & Tg$g %in% PGg & !orach),
  "no species of a genus presumed obligate mutualist typed f/n on bare attendance or presumed scores" =
    !any(weak & Tg$g %in% GPm),
  "no Lepidochrysops (outside Orachrysops clusters) typed f/n/m" =
    !any(Tg$g %in% "Lepidochrysops" & !orach & Tg$interaction_type %in% c("f", "n", "m"),
         na.rm = TRUE)
)
cat("all consistency checks passed\n")
```

## Release table with evidence strength

The evidence strength of a species' type counts the independent source groups whose direct records agree with it; the public dataset keeps one row per representative species.

```{r write_release_table}
# --- Inputs ---
# Species and ledger tables read as text; blank and "NA" are missing
read_out <- function(f) read.csv(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, f),
                                 colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE,
                                 na.strings = c("", "NA"))
traits <- read_out("species_traits.csv")
ledger <- read_out("evidence_ledger.csv")
release_dir <- file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "release")

# --- Direct class records ---
# Interaction-category records with a class (n, f, o, m, p), direct basis, not excluded
# and an accepted key
C <- ledger[ledger$claim_type == "interaction_category" & !is.na(ledger$class) &
              ledger$class %in% c("n", "f", "o", "m", "p") & ledger$basis %in% "direct" &
              !is.na(ledger$accepted_key) & ledger$record_use != "excluded", ]

# Independent source groups: the sources of one author or compilation count once
s <- C$source_id
C$grp <- ifelse(
  grepl("^fiedler", s), "Fiedler",
  ifelse(grepl("^heath|^gh_heath", s), "Heath",
         ifelse(grepl("^eastwood|^gh_eastwood|^braby|^gh_braby", s), "Eastwood/Braby",
                ifelse(grepl("^pierce|^boyle|^gh_pierce", s), "Pierce/Boyle",
                       ifelse(grepl("^schar", s), "Schaer", s)))))

# Records that observe the species itself
C$obs <- C$evidence_kind %in% "observation-this-species"

# --- Records that agree with the final class ---
# Coarse classes: n, f and obligate (m, p, o)
R <- traits[traits$is_representative == "TRUE", ]
fin <- setNames(R$interaction_type, R$gbif_key)
C$final <- fin[C$accepted_key]
C <- C[!is.na(C$final), ]
coarse <- c(n = "n", f = "f", m = "obl", p = "obl", o = "obl")
A <- C[coarse[C$class] == coarse[C$final], ]

# Per species: number of agreeing source groups, and whether any record is an observation
ev <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(A, A$accepted_key), function(z)
  data.frame(gbif_key = z$accepted_key[1], n_groups = length(unique(z$grp)),
             obs = any(z$obs))))
R <- merge(R, ev, by = "gbif_key", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

# --- Evidence strength ---
# strong: an observation of the species or >= 2 independent source groups agree
R$evidence_strength <- ifelse(
  is.na(R$interaction_type), NA_character_,
  ifelse(R$interaction_type_status %in% "decision_override", "curated_decision",
         ifelse(grepl("presumed", R$interaction_type_basis),
                "presumed_by_cited_author_or_genus",
                ifelse(is.na(R$n_groups), "other_direct",
                       ifelse(R$obs | R$n_groups >= 2, "strong",
                              "single_compilation_claim")))))

# --- Release table ---
# One row per representative species, with the canonical name as species
keep <- c("gbif_key", "canonical", "genus", "authorship", "cluster_id", "cluster_size",
          "interaction_type", "interaction_type_basis", "interaction_type_status",
          "evidence_strength", "cite_interaction_type", "associated_ants", "host_breadth",
          "cite_ants", "carnivory", "cite_carnivory", "wingspan_mm", "conflict_flag")
slim <- R[, keep]
names(slim)[names(slim) == "canonical"] <- "species"
slim <- slim[order(slim$genus, slim$species), ]
write_table(slim, file.path(release_dir, "species_interaction_dataset.csv"))
```

## Dictionary of the full species table

The dictionary describes every column of the species table and marks those kept in the release table; the notebook stops if a column is undocumented.

```{r write_column_dictionary}
# --- Column descriptions ---
# One c(column, description) per column of the full species table
dict <- rbind(
  # Species and duplicate cluster
  c("gbif_key", "GBIF Backbone accepted species key (one row per accepted key)"),
  c("species", "Accepted name with underscore"),
  c("canonical", "Accepted canonical name"),
  c("genus", "GBIF genus of the accepted name"),
  c("authorship", "Name authorship from GBIF"),
  c("in_legacy_aug24", "TRUE if the species was in the 2024 (legacy) dataset"),
  c("universe_status", "gbif_accepted or extra (non-GBIF taxon added by name decision)"),
  c("extra_reason", "Why an extra taxon is in the universe"),
  c("cluster_id",
    "Duplicate-species cluster (several GBIF keys for one biological species share an id)"),
  c("cluster_size", "Number of GBIF keys in the cluster"),
  c("representative_key", "Key of the cluster's representative row"),
  c("cluster_members", "All GBIF names in the cluster"),

  # Interaction type
  c("interaction_type",
    "n = no/myrmecoxenous, f = facultative, m = obligate mutualist, p = parasite; empty = not typed (no rule-based defaults)"),
  c("interaction_type_basis",
    "direct | direct (presumed ...) | curated decision: how the class was reached"),
  c("interaction_type_status",
    "agreed | single_source | conflict_unresolved | decision_override"),
  c("interaction_type_note", "Free-text note on the call"),
  c("interaction_type_presumption",
    "Confidence or justification of a presumed class (cited-author genus presumption or genus-consensus counts)"),
  c("cite_interaction_type", "Sources behind the class"),
  c("all_class_claims", "Every class claim in the ledger as source:class"),

  # Ants and partner breadth
  c("n_ant_genera_raw", "Ant genera recorded before qualifying-record filtering"),
  c("host_breadth", "Number of ant genera with qualifying records"),
  c("host_breadth_n_records", "Records behind host_breadth"),
  c("host_breadth_basis", "Basis of host_breadth"),
  c("associated_ants", "Qualifying ant taxa"),
  c("cite_ants", "Sources of ant records"),

  # Carnivory, plant specialisation and the wingspan of Schaer et al. 2018
  c("carnivory",
    "1 = larvae feed on animal matter (ant brood, hemipterans, ...), 0 = plant feeders; genus-consensus default (R12) where no direct record"),
  c("carnivory_basis", "direct or rule default (R12/R12b)"),
  c("cite_carnivory", "Sources of carnivory call"),
  c("plant_specialisation_schar", "Binary plant specialisation from Schaer et al. 2018"),
  c("fiedler1991_host_range", "Fiedler 1991 host-plant range"),
  c("wingspan_mm_schar", "Wingspan from Schaer et al. 2018"),

  # Evidence counts, conflicts and cluster flags
  c("n_ledger_rows", "Evidence-ledger rows for the species"),
  c("n_sources", "Distinct sources"),
  c("conflict_flag", "TRUE if sources disagree"),
  c("is_representative", "TRUE for the one row per cluster that carries the data"),
  c("gbif_duplicate_of", "Representative key for non-representative cluster members"),

  # Rule defaults (not part of the dataset)
  c("interaction_type_rule_default",
    "Class that the genus-consensus (R11) or phylogeny (R14) rules WOULD give; NOT part of the dataset"),
  c("interaction_type_rule_default_note", "Which rule and evidence"),

  # Wingspan
  c("wingspan_mm", "Merged wingspan"),
  c("wingspan_min_mm", "Minimum"),
  c("wingspan_max_mm", "Maximum"),
  c("wingspan_source", "Source of wingspan"),
  c("wingspan_basis", "direct or imputed"))

# --- Dictionary table ---
# Marks the columns of the full species table and those kept in the release table
# (canonical is the species column of the release table)
dict <- data.frame(column = dict[, 1], description = dict[, 2], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dict$in_full_table <- dict$column %in% names(traits)
dict$in_release_table <- dict$column %in% names(slim) | (dict$column == "canonical")

# The notebook stops if a column of the species table is undocumented
missing <- setdiff(names(traits), dict$column)
if (length(missing)) stop("undocumented columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
write_table(dict, file.path(release_dir, "column_dictionary.csv"))
cat("release table:", nrow(slim), "species,", sum(!is.na(slim$interaction_type)),
    "typed; dictionary:", nrow(dict), "columns\n")
```
